subject: Quick thought on The Cosmetic Dentists of Austin's site + a live preview
body: Hi there, I came across The Cosmetic Dentists of Austin while researching top practices in Texas and was genuinely impressed by your LVI Fellow credentials and your four-day Express Smile Makeover concierge service for out-of-town guests. While browsing your current site, I noticed that dense text blocks and inconsistent button styling can sometimes slow down mobile visitors who are ready to request a consultation. To see how these areas could be smoothed out, I went ahead and built a modern, high-performance prototype for your practice. It features a cleaner split-hero layout, prominent placement for your 500+ five-star reviews right above the fold, and standardized conversion buttons. You can explore the live preview here: https://nayom-preview.pages.dev/biz_0x865b4a0023331e97_0x1d39d347423e3b00. If you like the cleaner direction or want me to adjust anything, I'd be glad to send over the code or chat for a few minutes. No worries at all if you are completely happy with your current setup!
key_improvements: Streamlined dense text blocks into clean, scannable layouts
Prominently featured 500+ five-star reviews above the fold
Standardized button styling and label clarity for better conversion
